# Support Matrix

<!-- Generated by `python -m forge.docsgen`. Do not edit directly. -->

Generated directly from `forge.verify.supported_matrix.MATRIX` —
the complete, real (kind, backend) support matrix. Every command
that processes flow declarations validates against this matrix
before doing any further work (`validate_flow_matrix()`).

| Kind | Classification | Default backend | Allowed backends | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `full_chip_rtl` | supported | `xsim` | `verilator`, `xsim` | Full-chip RTL simulation via Xilinx XSIM or Verilator (gen-top required) |
| `hls_cosim` | experimental | `csim` | `csim` | Legacy alias for hls_csim; use 'hls_csim' in new designs |
| `hls_csim` | supported | `csim` | `csim` | HLS C-simulation via compiled testbench binary |
| `reduced_chain_rtl` | experimental | `xsim` | `xsim` | Multi-module RTL chain simulation; TB generation and port extraction are not yet proven for this scope on the canonical path |
| `single_module_rtl` | supported | `xsim` | `verilator`, `xsim` | Single HLS-generated RTL module via Xilinx XSIM or Verilator |

## Supported kinds

- `full_chip_rtl`
- `hls_csim`
- `single_module_rtl`

## Experimental kinds

- `hls_cosim`
- `reduced_chain_rtl`
